raw_response:
I’m 50 this year, and with only 16.9 mu I can’t farm like the big operators. What I care about is steady income and not taking too much risk. Cotton is still my main crop because I know it better and have done it for years, but I’ll keep a smaller piece in maize so the house has some grain and I’m not betting everything on one crop. Since some people in my family work off-farm, I can’t manage too many fine operations, so I’ll keep fertilizer and irrigation at the level I can afford and handle. If cotton looks weak, I’ll add a little topdressing, but I won’t push too hard because water and labor both cost money.
